headline: IRAN 🕌 Calls US 💣 STRIKE on WEDDING 💒 a WAR CRIME 😈 as Trump 🍊 DENIES Civilian 🍔 TARGETS
text:
IRAN 🕌 is SCREAMING 🗣️ bloody MURDER 🩸 after a US 💥 missile STRIKE 💣 turned a FAMILY 💑 wedding 🎉 in southern IRAN 🏜️ into a NIGHTMARE 😱 killing FOUR 🕳️ including TWO 👦👧 little KIDS 🍼 at the ceremony 🎊 in Kuhestak 🏠!! The Iranian Red Crescent 🩹 crew found SHRAPNEL 🧨 from the BLAST 💥 ripping through the home 🏚️ during the party 🎉 leaving Zarkhatoon Taheri 50 🧓 Kolsum Mallahi Nazhdnia 43 👵 Mohammad Mallahi 16 🧑‍🦱 and tiny Amirali Karimi FOUR 🍼 DEAD ☠️!! Iranian foreign ministry SPINMASTER 🌀 Esmaeil Baqaei straight up called it a straight WAR CRIME ⚖️ while daddy Ali Mallahi 🧔 the BRIDE'S 😢 father sobbed on state TV 📺 "this was my DAUGHTER'S 💍 wedding and now it's just rubble 🏚️ thank GOD 🙏 the body count wasn't higher"!!

US Central Command 🛡️ is playing the innocent CARD 🃏 swearing they "NEVER TARGET CIVILIANS 🚫👥" even as Centcom captain Tim Hawkins 🪖 told the BBC 📡 they knew about the SIRIK 🏖️ reports but unlike the IRGC 🦅 the US doesn't aim at kids 🧒!! Meanwhile another FOURTEEN ☠️ bodies dropped from separate STRIKES 💥 around Ahvaz and Aqajari in Khuzestan 🏙️ plus IRGC lost four missile nerds 🧪 in Kermanshah and three Basij boys 🪖 on Lavan island 🏝️!! The Khatam al-Anbiya HQ 🏰 warned America that ops against US forces will keep going until Washington "REGRETS" its crimes 😤 with explosions popping off in Hormozgan Sistan-Baluchestan Kerman and Khuzestan provinces 🌋!! BBC Verify 🕵️ measured the telecom tower 📡 was only 112 meters from the wedding house 🏠 and the blast damage was 130 meters north confirming the shrapnel party 🧨 wasn't exactly surgical 🪒!!

In full retaliation 🔥 Iran went full SEND IT 🚀 launching BALLISTIC MISSILES ☄️ and DRONES 🛰️ at US spots in Jordan 🇯🇴 Kuwait 🇰🇼 Iraq 🏛️ Bahrain 🏴‍☠️ and the UAE 🏙️ claiming they smoked the Marine barracks 🛏️ at Camp Titin on Jordan's Gulf of Aqaba coast 🌊!! Jordanian forces 🪖 knocked down thirteen of those ballistic bad boys 💣 with ten exploding midair 💥 and three flopping into empty desert 🏜️ while Reuters 📝 says US officials reported ZERO casualties 🙅‍♂️!! Kuwait's fire department 🚒 had to hose down a residential complex 🔥 after one drone slipped through but again no bodies 🪦 and local Iraqi media whispered a US spy balloon 🎈 got popped by Iranian drones over Irbil 🏙️!! The IRGC 🦅 bragged they wrecked a maintenance center 🛠️ warehouses 📦 and equipment in northern Kurdistan but Iraqi officials stayed suspiciously quiet 🤐!!

Trump 🍊 himself hyped Tuesday's strikes as "LARGE AND POWERFUL" 💪 while Centcom confirmed they smashed air defence sites 🛡️ radar dishes 📡 and maritime assets 🚢 in the south!! This all kicked off after the IRGC tried hitting American forces and commercial ships 🚢 in the Strait of Hormuz 🌊 that magical chokepoint carrying TWENTY PERCENT of global oil and gas ⛽!! Two Filipino sailors 🇵🇭 died when their Saudi tanker SIDR got caught in a "security incident" near those waters and two more tankers caught fire 🔥 after the US allegedly guided them onto mines in an "illegal route" 🛤️!! Iran had paused for a hot minute after that June MoU 📜 promising to reopen the strait and cool the nuclear beef ☢️ but that paper peace 💌 collapsed faster than a cheap date 😬 leading to this endless horny cycle of sanctions 🚫 missiles 🚀 and blockades 🚧!!

The Iranian military's top brass 🧠 swore these ops against American forces will CONTINUE 🏃‍♂️ until the US "regrets its crimes" with parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf calling America straight up SATAN 👿!! Earlier the US and Israel had smoked Iran's supreme leader ☠️ back in February kicking off this whole mess and Iran clapped back by shutting down the strait 🌊 and lobbing rockets at everyone in the Gulf 🏜️!! Now six months deep Trump is claiming wins but the wedding blood 🩸 is making Iran scream war crime while the US keeps insisting their munitions 🎯 were aiming at towers not toasts 🍞!! The IRCS initially said five dead before correcting to four and the shrapnel pics 📸 are getting forensics experts arguing if it was a SLAM-ER or JSOW but either way that wedding 🎉 got absolutely COOKED 🍳 by great power edging 😩!!
